[RFCS.16.6] Shared bodies are distinguished by number, never by an in-body discriminator.
An atom is identified by its own oneof field number alone ([RFCS.16.1]); were two
atoms to reuse one protobuf body, a reader would tell them apart by that number and
**never** by a discriminator *inside* the body. There is one number per atom and no
in-band discriminator.

Every live oracle atom carries a body of its own (`proto/test_oracle.proto`). `SchemaDef`
and `Slot` share their bodies with the DSC container, not with each other, and hold
one number each ([RFCS.3.2]).
